roles.title: Software Engineer II
roles.summary: Promoted to Software Engineer II in June 2025. I own end-to-end delivery of full-stack and AI systems for US enterprise clients in supply chain, fintech, compliance, and healthcare.

projects.title: AI Coaching Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Built an AI platform that turns recorded coaching sessions into prep briefs, follow-ups and client insights. Engineered an event-driven intake pipeline (Read.ai → Pub/Sub → Temporal) with LLM meeting classification and a review queue for ambiguous cases, plus Salesforce sync, Microsoft SSO with account-scoped RBAC, and an audited RAG document hub (Claude/Gemini on Vertex AI).

projects.title: AI Inventory Management Platform
projects.description: Built an AI-driven platform tracking stock across multiple warehouses for a US distributor. Architected multi-tenant microservices with Azure AD SSO; engineered an ERP sync pipeline with bulk upserts that significantly cut sync time; shipped ML demand forecasting with automated reorder recommendations.

projects.title: Agentic Loan Processing POC
projects.description: Architected an event-driven multi-agent system for SBA loan processing: a wide range of loan documents classified and extracted via LLM tool-use loops with parallel agent runs, an auditor agent cross-matching documents, and a human-in-the-loop review dashboard. Client approved it for full build-out.

projects.title: Enterprise CX Marketplace
projects.description: Replaced a licensed procurement tool with an in-house white-label platform, eliminating licensing spend. Made vendor RFP responses real-time, replacing scheduled polling with native in-app submission, and re-engineered vendor filtering for near-instant search. Owned frontend, backend, AWS infra, and releases.

roles.title: Software Engineer I
roles.summary: Full-stack development on client products across edtech, data infrastructure, environmental engineering, and healthcare.

projects.title: Environmental Telemetry Portal
projects.description: Architected a portal for industrial wastewater treatment systems across multiple sites: Snowflake data ingestion, role-based authorization, automated user provisioning, and visualization of hydraulic state, sensor outputs, and BOD analysis under strict data-sensitivity requirements.

projects.title: Data Center Monitoring Portal
projects.description: Built the frontend for a monitoring portal supporting waterless-cooled AI data centers in the US: real-time operational dashboards, system-state visualization, Microsoft authentication, and Azure Static Web Apps deployment.

projects.title: Accessibility & Learning Platform
projects.description: Built interactive math-input interfaces enabling students with motor and dysgraphia challenges to write math digitally; owned deployment via Jenkins, AWS, and NGINX, and worked directly with the client on requirements and iteration.

projects.title: Safety & Compliance Management System
projects.description: Built a dual-app system (admin portal + offline-first field app) for field teams on no-network industrial sites, with automatic conflict-resolution sync, RBAC, and audit trails.

also.title: Healthcare analytics platform
also.description: Garmin/Fitbit integrations and ML nutrition insights (FastAPI, GCP).

highlight.title: AI/ML Feature Integration
highlight.description: Designed and implemented AI-powered features across multiple products including RAG pipelines, vector databases, embedding pipelines, and knowledge retrieval systems.
